examples.en: Their retinal cells are also not excessively sensitive to red components of moderately bright light.
examples.zh: 它们的视网膜细胞对中等亮度光线中的红色成分也不太敏感。

examples.en: The new measure will specify to moderately relax the quota of the self-produced products of foreign-invested enterprise for the domestic market.
examples.zh: 新办法将明确适度放宽外商投资企业自产产品在国内市场的配额。
